subject.title: feat(ledger): add immutable action history core

question: Should ClawSweeper adopt this immutable action-ledger v1 contract as the permanent source of truth for future workflow action history?
rationale: The patch can prove internal invariants, but it cannot decide the long-term compatibility, privacy, storage, projection, and operational commitments that production adoption creates.

options.title: Adopt and freeze v1
options.body: Accept the current hardened contract and require the stacked production integration to preserve and prove these invariants.

options.title: Narrow the initial contract
options.body: Defer nonessential event families or projection behavior before any production writer creates durable compatibility obligations.

options.title: Pause the ledger program
options.body: Keep existing records authoritative until retention, deterministic rebuilding, and operational ownership are settled.

recommendation.title: Adopt and freeze v1
recommendation.body: Accept the current hardened contract and require the stacked production integration to preserve and prove these invariants.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history shows the broadest ownership of the review, publication, durable-state, workflow, and release architecture affected by this permanent contract.
